brand.name: New Vision Fellowship
brand.mission: To multiply God's glory on the earth.
brand.vision: Multitudes shaped and sent for Christ.

core_values: Grace and truth are not rivals
The gospel transforms how we live
People matter to God and to us

on_ramps.description: The four on-ramps to a fuller faith, drawn from Acts 2:41-47. Present in this order.

items.name: Gather
items.summary: We gather to worship by attending one service and serving during one — Attend One, Serve One.

items.name: Give
items.summary: Generosity keeps the mission multiplying — and it is first a heart issue.

items.name: Group
items.summary: God designed the Christian life to thrive as believers share life together.

items.name: Go
items.summary: Multiplication spreads from our neighborhoods to the nations.

clay_stages.description: Clay in the Potter's Hands — our picture of personal spiritual growth, from Isaiah 64:8. Five ordered stages, each multiplying something.

primary.name: Brand Leaf Green
primary.usage: Primary brand green on light backgrounds. Rules, kickers, accents, buttons.

tones.name: Green Deep
tones.usage: Small text, links, and labels on light backgrounds where #5f9a32 lacks contrast.

tones.name: Green Bright
tones.usage: Accent green for DARK backgrounds only. Never on paper.

secondary.name: Olive
secondary.usage: Muted supporting green. Scripture rules, eyebrow labels, the road motif.

tones.name: Olive Deep
tones.usage: Dark green panels and contrast columns with white text.

neutral_dark.name: Charcoal
neutral_dark.usage: Dark backgrounds — covers, section dividers, action slides. Never pure black.

neutral_light.name: Paper
neutral_light.usage: Primary light background. Warm off-white — never pure white.

tones.name: Paper Card
tones.usage: Cards, wells, and inset panels on light backgrounds.

ink.usage: Primary body and heading text on light backgrounds.

hairline.usage: Dividers and card borders on light backgrounds.

accents.description: Four earthy, green-anchored category colors. Used to color-code the four on-ramps and to differentiate sections. Never introduce a fifth.

rules: Never use pure black (#000000) or pure white (#ffffff) as a background. Use Charcoal and Paper.
On light backgrounds use Brand Leaf Green (#5f9a32) or Green Deep (#42701f). On dark backgrounds switch to Green Bright (#74ca33).
Greens lead. The four accent colors differentiate categories. Warm neutrals carry everything else.
Limit any single composition to one or two background colors.

display.usage: All headings, titles, labels, kickers, numbers, and UI. Tight letter-spacing (-0.01em to -0.028em) on large headings; wide tracking (0.12em to 0.34em) on small uppercase labels.

body.usage: All long-form and body copy. Line-height approximately 1.4 to 1.6. Apply text-wrap: pretty.

script.usage: Warm human accents only — a greeting, a value name, a caption lead-in such as 'We are…'. Never for body copy or critical information. One flourish per composition.

display_alternates.description: Used only in the On-Ramp cover lockup, set in Canva. Not required for general brand work.

scale.note: Sizes are expressed for a 1920x1080 canvas. Scale proportionally for other media. For print, body copy sits at 12-15px on a Letter page.

minimums.projection_note: For projected media, minimum text size is viewing_distance / 200. At 40 feet that is 2.4 inches. Never smaller.

md.usage: Cards, wells, and inset panels. The default.

lg.usage: Large panels on projected or oversized media.

lockups.name: Stacked Lockup
lockups.description: NEW VISION above FELLOWSHIP with the leaf mark. The primary logo. Prefer this for covers, title cards, and anywhere with vertical room.

assets.note: The default logo. Charcoal wordmark with the green leaf mark.
Two-colour lockup with a white wordmark, for charcoal and photographic backgrounds.
Single-colour white. Use where the green leaf would not reproduce.
Single-colour charcoal. One-ink print and faxable documents.

lockups.name: Horizontal Wordmark
lockups.description: Single-line wordmark. Use in narrow horizontal spaces — headers, footers, corner marks, email signatures.

assets.note: White wordmark with the green leaf mark retained.

lockups.name: Leaf Mark
lockups.description: The two-leaf icon alone. Use as a small decorative accent, favicon, or avatar — never as a substitute for the full logo in primary placements.

rules: Prefer SVG for all vector and programmatic use.
Match the variant to the background. Every asset entry carries a use_on field and a colors array — read them before placing a logo.
On light backgrounds use the color variant (charcoal wordmark). On dark or photographic backgrounds use color_on_dark or white — the charcoal wordmark will not read.
Maintain clearspace equal to the height of the leaf mark on all sides.
Never stretch, recolor, rotate, add effects to, or place the logo on a busy background without a darkening veil.
The stacked lockup is the default choice. Reach for the horizontal wordmark only when vertical space is constrained.
The horizontal wordmark has an aspect ratio of roughly 22:1. In constrained layouts, size it by width and never let it crowd adjacent navigation or type.

initiatives.name: Life Groups
initiatives.description: 8-16 people meeting weekly in host homes across three 10-week trimesters, to Connect, Reflect, and Protect.

initiatives.name: Who's Your One?
initiatives.description: Identify one person in your circles who is far from God — pray for them, share the gospel, and invite them to church.

voice.summary: New Vision sounds warm, grounded, and hopeful. We are inviting people into something bigger than themselves, so we open doors rather than push. Grace and truth are not rivals — we say hard things kindly and clearly, never hedging them into vagueness. Plain language carries profound ideas. Concrete detail earns trust where superlatives do not. Every piece points to one clear next step.
voice.statement: Write like a trusted friend who is a little further down the road: warm, direct, unhurried. Invite people in — never recruit, pressure, or hype. Use plain words for deep things, and say hard truths kindly and clearly. Be specific: real names, real numbers, real next steps. Write to 'you' in active voice, mostly short sentences, with one warm flourish per piece.
do: Choose the shorter, plainer word; explain any church term a guest would not know
Be specific — real names, real numbers, real streets earn trust
Invite warmly: 'There's a seat for you here'
Say hard truths kindly and plainly; never soften them into vagueness
End with one concrete next step: verb, what happens, where to go
Keep sentences mostly short; read aloud and cut anything breathless
Use Title Case for titles, ALL CAPS for short labels, sentence case elsewhere
Add exactly one warm human flourish per piece
Keep paragraphs to one idea, three or four sentences maximum
dont: No urgency or FOMO — avoid 'don't miss out', 'limited time', 'last chance'
No hype words: amazing, incredible, life-changing, unlock
No corporate speak: leverage, utilize, engagement, onboarding, stakeholders
No insider shorthand used cold — unpacking, doing life, pouring into, seasons
No hedging with just, kind of, sort of, maybe
Never imply anyone is behind, failing, or missing out by not participating
Do not write about 'people' in third person when you mean the reader
Do not substitute superlatives for evidence — show the number instead
No more than one script flourish or exclamation point per piece
Never use straight quotes or apostrophes; always use curly
example_phrases: There's a seat for you here.
Let's get moving for the Master.
Serving isn't the finish line, it's the starting line.
Grace and truth are not rivals.
If you can find us, you can worship with us.

kicker_lockup.description: The recurring section-header motif. A small uppercase green kicker, then a large Archivo title, then a short rule bar.
kicker_lockup.spec: Kicker: Archivo 800, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.26em, primary green. Title: Archivo 900, tight tracking. Rule: 104px wide, 7px tall, rounded, primary green.

card.spec: Background Paper Card (#f1ece2), radius 10-20px, generous padding, and frequently a 5-14px left or top accent border in the category color.

contrast_columns.description: Two side-by-side columns used to contrast ideas — one light, one dark.
contrast_columns.spec: Left column Paper Card with ink-soft text. Right column Olive Deep (#37461f) with white text and inline bold Green Bright highlights on key phrases.

image_veil.description: The treatment that makes white text legible over photography.
image_veil.spec: Place a bottom-weighted linear gradient over the image: rgba(36,32,29,0.15) at 0%, rgba(36,32,29,0.05) at 38%, rgba(36,32,29,0.60) at 72%, rgba(36,32,29,0.88) at 100%. Set caption text in white Archivo 900 with a Kaushan Script lead-in above it in Green Bright.
image_veil.warning: Do not use blurred text-shadow for legibility. Print and PDF engines rasterize large-blur shadows into visible rectangles. Use the gradient veil instead.

road_motif.description: A winding road on dark asphalt, used on covers and back covers to carry the On-Ramp metaphor.
road_motif.spec: Dark charcoal radial base, an olive green road path with a dashed center line, and a subtle noise texture. Always veiled before type is placed on it.

timeline.spec: A vertical spine with a gradient from primary green to olive, the year on the left in Archivo 900 green, and alternating filled and outlined dots on the line. Dots sit above the spine.

do: Use warm neutrals, confident large headings, and generous whitespace
Color-code categories with the four accent colors
Pair real photography with the gradient veil for text legibility
Lead sections with the kicker-title-rule lockup
Use flex or grid with gap for all sibling layout
dont: No aggressive gradient backgrounds or glassmorphism
No pure black or pure white, and no cold grays
No competing accent colors beyond the defined four
Do not use Inter, Roboto, or Arial — the Archivo and Source Serif 4 pairing is the signature

print.note: Every placed image must meet 350 DPI at its final placed size, not at its native size.

rules: Start with this file. It is the single machine-readable source of truth for New Vision Fellowship's brand.
Resolve every asset path against base_url. All paths are relative to the repository root.
Use Brand Leaf Green (#5f9a32) as the primary color on light backgrounds and Green Bright (#74ca33) on dark ones.
Set all headings in Archivo and all body copy in Source Serif 4. Use Kaushan Script only for a single warm accent per composition.
Prefer the stacked logo lockup. Match the variant to the background using each asset's use_on field: color on light, color_on_dark or white on dark.
Follow the voice object for all copy. Read brand-guidelines.md for the full tone and usage rules.
When producing print output, honor the print object: 0.125in bleed, 350 DPI, CMYK.
